reason: My parents already help me with the bank paperwork in India, and my relative can handle the forms for free. I compare every rupee of spread, so paying $199 on top of the exchange rate to move 10 lakh feels like a lot.
objection: My relative in India can sort this out for free, so why pay $199 for forms they can file for nothing? I would also want to see the real all-in cost against Wise or my bank before trusting a newer company.
would_change_my_mind: A fee under about $80 for 10 lakh, plus proof that the all-in cost (fee and exchange rate) beats what my relative and my bank would cost me.
